title: Email: Fw: Jeff Moss (@JeffMossDSR) mentioned you on Twitter!

content.subject: Fw: Jeff Moss (@JeffMossDSR) mentioned you on Twitter!

content.text:
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Thursday, November 27, 2014 2:24 PM
To: Myers, Gene <gmyers@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Jeff Moss (@JeffMossDSR) mentioned you on Twitter! 
 
I shouldn’t have done that. I knew he was going to mention it. You know who commented on my pictures though and I don’t want her to get dragged into this.

From: Myers, Gene 
Sent: Thursday, November 27, 2014 2:17 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony; Sipple, George; Bull, Kevin
Subject: FW: Jeff Moss (@JeffMossDSR) mentioned you on Twitter!

From: Jeff Moss (via Twitter) [mailto:notify@twitter.com] 
Sent: Thursday, November 27, 2014 2:12 PM
To: Myers, Gene
Subject: Jeff Moss (@JeffMossDSR) mentioned you on Twitter!
Rats. Anthony Fenech changed his Facebook preferences on me so now I can’t see his pictures. Must have been more hugging with @GeneMyers. - @JeffMossDSR

Gene Myers, 
You were mentioned in a Tweet!
Rats. Anthony Fenech changed his Facebook preferences on me so now I can’t see his pictures. Must have been more hugging with @GeneMyers.
